answer: One concrete defense: require each agent to post a refundable economic bond before it can transact. Spinning up a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand bonds, so sybils stop being free. A staked agent that misbehaves gets slashed, turning its own capital into a beacon that warns honest peers. No agent is an island here: reputation is anchored to stake as hard as basalt, so forging crowds becomes prohibitively expensive rather than trivial.
